environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on a standard EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) running as a systemd service under the 'app' user. SMTP relay is Postfix on localhost:25 configured as an open relay for the internal subnet. The service runs with standard process isolation (separate user, no root). Network egress is unrestricted. The subject parameter is directly interpolated into SMTP headers without CRLF sanitization, allowing injection of arbitrary headers including BCC to external addresses.

config.network: VPC with unrestricted egress, no outbound SMTP filtering
config.filesystem: standard ext4, app has read/write to /var/log/contact-service
